{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once, as required by the population definition
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_fraction = deduplicated_data['severity'].eq('severe').mean()

print(f"Deduplicated shape: {deduplicated_data.shape}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline: {severe_fraction}")"}
